assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md contains 'Workflow Mode Decision' section with 'Selected mode: feature-branch' and detailed rationale citing three atomicity indicators: 'Coordinated schema migration', 'Cross-cutting refactor', and 'Tightly coupled components'. It quotes the feature description: 'All changes must land together: merging the migration without the code changes would break all advisory queries.'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is task 1 (first) in the plan. summary-comment.md confirms it as '#1 Create feature branch TC-9005 from main' marked '(bookend)'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is task 8 (last) in the plan. summary-comment.md confirms it as '#8 Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main' marked '(bookend)'.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All intermediate tasks (2-7) have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-advisory-status-enum-migration.md, task-3-update-seaorm-entities.md, task-4-update-advisory-service-endpoints.md, task-5-update-ingestion-pipeline.md, task-6-update-advisory-tests.md, task-7-update-architecture-docs.md.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: Task 2 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 3 ('Depends on: Task 1' and Task 2), Task 4 ('Depends on: Task 1' and Task 3), Task 5 ('Depends on: Task 1' and Task 3), Task 6 ('Depends on: Task 1' and Tasks 2, 4, 5). Documentation task 7 lists implementation tasks (Tasks 2, 3, 4, 5) as dependencies instead of Task 1, which is permitted by the assertion.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md lists dependencies on Tasks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (all non-documentation intermediate tasks) and also Task 7 (documentation). All five non-documentation intermediate tasks are accounted for.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Bookend tasks (non-documentation task files) are missing required sections. task-1-create-feature-branch.md lacks 'Files to Modify', 'Files to Create', and 'Implementation Notes' sections. task-8-merge-feature-branch.md likewise lacks these sections. The assertion only exempts documentation tasks, not bookend tasks. Non-bookend intermediate tasks (2-6) all contain the required sections. Documentation task 7 has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements as required by the exemption.

assertion_results.text: The plan includes a workflow:feature-branch label decision to be applied to the feature issue
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to the feature issue TC-9005.' summary-comment.md also confirms: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label is applied to the feature issue.'

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:', not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string
assertion_results.evidence: Digest files exist for all 8 tasks (task-1-digest.md through task-8-digest.md), but every digest contains a placeholder value: 'sha256-md:<computed-after-jira-creation>' instead of an actual 64-character lowercase hex hash. The assertion explicitly requires 'not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string.' For example, task-1-digest.md reads: '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<computed-after-jira-creation>' followed by a note explaining 'In production, this digest is computed by...' None of the digest files contain a real SHA-256 hash.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: No output file contains any evidence of convention-aware enrichment or applicability validation. None of the task files (task-1 through task-8), impact-map.md, or summary-comment.md contain 'Applies:', 'convention', 'applicability', or any reference to shared/convention-applicability-rules.md. No conventions are mentioned at all in any output file.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md contains '## Inherited Field Values' section stating 'Priority: High — propagated to all created tasks and epics' and shows the additional_fields JSON with '"priority": {"name": "High"}' applied to all created issues.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md documents fixVersion inheritance: 'Fix Version: RHTPA 2.0.0 — propagated to all created tasks and epics (fixVersion scope defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section is configured)' and shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' in the additional_fields JSON block.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an '## Inherited Field Values' section documenting both propagated fields: 'Priority: High — propagated to all created tasks and epics' and 'Fix Version: RHTPA 2.0.0 — propagated to all created tasks and epics'. It also includes a JSON block showing the exact additional_fields values applied to all created issues.
